exposure: Maternal exposure to 41 urinary antibiotics and two metabolites (measured in first, second, and third trimesters)
cohort: The study included 2475 pregnant women from the Ma'anshan Birth Cohort, whose children were assessed for emotional and behavioural problems at four years of age.
finding: Maternal mixed antibiotic exposure during the first and second trimesters was associated with an increased risk of emotional problems and hyperactivity-inattention in children at four years of age.
